# LangGraph Swarm Python — Multi-Agent Framework

> Python framework for multi-agent coordination using LangGraph.
> Adapted for Genesis Conductor by Igor Holt.

## Features
- Multi-agent orchestration
- LangGraph integration
- Swarm intelligence patterns

## Genesis Conductor Integration
- Compatible with A2A v0.3 protocol
- Can be used with Ambient Access Layer
